contracts: (Independent witness output proves evidence-invalid for the isolated binding-deletion fixture without unrelated input changes.) AND (Omission fixture is rejected and every discovered VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing call has exactly one manifest entry with no orphan entries.) AND (Repeated selector runs yield expected-category failure with separate infrastructure controls.)
selector_intents: Run the NFR-2 auditability selector with a binding-deletion fixture that also mutates an unrelated control input; the isolation check must fail.
Run the isolated malformed-fixture negative-Probe selector repeatedly with controls separated; fail if the defect does not fail or category/control attribution is inconsistent.
Select the VDD omission fixture; closure must fail when caller presence is removed while the manifest remains bidirectionally complete.
